title: Wouldn't buy again and wouldn't recommend
text: Wouldn't buy again and wouldn't recommend. This vacuum works okay.  I have had it almost a year and regret my decision to buy it.  It has gotten to where the battery runs out fast.  I use this most every day.  I just took brush to see how well it was working and got a lot of dirty and dog hair out of the  carpet.  I wouldn't recommend this to anyone.  I just noticed too, they have upped the price $30 since I bought mine.

BISSELL Lift-Off Floors and More Pet

The Lift-Off Floors & More PET is designed with convenience in mind. It provides powerful cordless cleaning and is ready to go for quick clean up. With its 2-in-1 design you have the benefits of an effective stick vacuum and hand vacuum in one! The removable hand vacuum includes a rubberized nozzle that pulls out pet hair found on furniture, stairs, and other areas that hair collects. Also, with the 2-way folding handle you can easily reach to clean under furniture as well as fold down for easy storage. The Lift-Off Floors & More PET is safe to use on virtually all surfaces. Turn the brush roll off to easily clean hard floor surfaces such as tile, laminate and wood. Turn the brush roll on to easily clean low pile carpet and area rugs.
